_what: What the sweep that ends computer grants left unused (do-work/end-computer-grants-left-unused.mjs) decides and says. The engine holds no end and reads none (trillion-rust src/tool_runs/tools/computer/grants.rs): a grant is admitted by being present, and it keeps two facts, granted_at and last_used, which its list answers. The person's own condition is here: a grant that has gone `unused_days` without a use ends, `remind_days` before it ends the person is reminded by one row in `reminder.list`, and a use renews it by moving last_used. The owner's decision case source:bWVzc2FnZXMtYmVjb21lLXNlZWRzOmdyYW50LWxhcHNlLWZvci1haS1zZXNzaW9uLWZvbGRlcnMtMjAyNi0xMS0xMw (option ninety-days-with-reminder) is the default; a run may be given other numbers as its input. The decision that a condition is a row the person holds and a wake they switched on acts on it is case source:bm8tZ3JhbnQtY29uZGl0aW9uLWluLWVuZ2luZS1jb2RlOndoZXJlLWNvbmRpdGlvbnMtbGl2ZS0yMDI2LTExLTE2.

reminder._what: One reminder is one row of kind `kind` at `prefix` + a name made from the tool, the capability and the time the grant was last used or accepted, so a grant that is used gets no reminder, and an old reminder of a grant that was used since, ended or is no longer found is removed. `list` is the task list the row is put in.

words.reminder: The computer grant of {capability} to {tool} ends on {ends} unless it is used first. Run {tool} once to keep it, or leave it and it ends.
words.swept: Ended {ended} computer grants left unused, reminded about {reminded}, {waiting} stand.
words.sweep_nothing: No computer grant has gone unused long enough to end: reminded about {reminded}, {waiting} stand.
